title: This Temple Texas Landmark Could Change the Local Real Estate Market
description:
In this episode, we explore the long-awaited revival of the Hawn Hotel—one of Temple, Texas' most iconic buildings. After sitting vacant for over 40 years, this historic landmark is getting a multi-million dollar renovation, and the impact on Temple’s downtown, property values, and real estate market could be huge.

Whether you’re a local, a homebuyer, or an investor, this project marks a turning point for the city—and an opportunity you won't want to miss.
